Dewy specimen glass and a spectral germination scanner glow softly behind her. Keep her lower face large, frontal, relaxed, and unobstructed. Her gently closed lips show two naturally raised philtral columns framing one centered vertical groove from the nose base to the upper lip, meeting a clearly paired double-arc Cupid's-bow contour across the upper-lip border. Gentle lateral surface light skims these shallow planes so the columns, central depression, and twin upper-lip arcs read as plausible skin relief rather than makeup or graphic lines. Prioritize realistic pores, restrained color, precise mouth-scale focus, and a calm scientific atmosphere.
